Doublet
The gene expression profile shows a strong plasmacytoid dendritic cell (pDC) signature (TCF4, LILRA4, CLEC4C, IL3RA, IRF8, IRF7) co-occurring with plasma cell/B cell markers (JCHAIN, MZB1, DERL3, IGKC), while the surface protein profile is dominated by platelet markers (CD41, CD62P, CLEC2, CD61). This conflicting combination of pDC mRNA, plasma cell genes, and platelet ADTs indicates a doublet containing a pDC, likely a plasma cell/plasmablast, and a platelet.
